_purpose: Verified rate/limit/date registry for one assessment year. Scripts and modules read values ONLY from here. If verified_on is >90 days old, or the AY differs from the return being prepared, re-verify every field online (official sources first) and rewrite this file before computing.
_source_policy: Priority: (1) Income-tax Act / Finance Act text, (2) CBDT notification/circular/rule, (3) incometax.gov.in or incometaxindia.gov.in portal FAQ/utility, (4) secondary sites as explanatory material only — never the sole authority for a rate or deadline. Each block lists 'primary' (authoritative) and optionally 'explanatory' sources.
governing_act: Income-tax Act, 1961 (the Income-tax Act, 2025 renumbering applies from AY 2027-28 — for later AYs verify section numbers under both Acts)

due_dates.note: Belated returns (s.139(4)) close 31 Dec 2026. Revised returns (s.139(5)) run to the end of the AY, 31 Mar 2027, but attract a fee under s.234I when filed after 31 Dec 2026 (Finance Act 2026, effective 1 Mar 2026).

itr_form_eligibility.note: CBDT notification of 30 Mar 2026: ITR-1 and ITR-4 for AY 2026-27 permit up to TWO house properties (any mix of self-occupied/let-out, no brought-forward HP loss). ITR-1 also permits s.112A LTCG up to Rs 1.25L with no carry-forward. All other disqualifiers unchanged (non-resident/RNOR, business income for ITR-1, director, unlisted shares, foreign assets, 194N TDS, deferred ESOP tax, agri income > 5000).

rebate_87a.note: s.115BAC(1A) proviso: rebate applies only to tax on slab-rate income; NO rebate against 111A, 112A, 112, 115BBH or other special-rate tax
Old-regime 87A applies to tax on total income INCLUDING s.111A STCG, but s.112A(6) bars it against 112A LTCG tax; conservatively not applied against 115BBH VDA tax either

basic_exemption_adjustment.note: Resident individual/HUF only: unused basic-exemption limit first reduces taxable s.111A STCG and s.112A/112 LTCG (provisos to those sections) before the special rate applies. NOT available to non-residents, and never against s.115BBH VDA income.

surcharge.enhanced_tier_exclusion: The 25%/37% tiers apply to the non-CG/dividend component only when total income EXCLUDING 111A/112/112A gains and dividends crosses 2Cr/5Cr; otherwise the whole surcharge is capped at 15%

capital_gains.debt_mf_post_2023_04_01: always slab rate regardless of holding

interest_and_fees.advance_tax_exempt: Resident individual aged 60+ with no business/professional income is NOT liable to advance tax (s.207(2)) — 234B/234C nil
interest_and_fees.deferred_income_relief_234c: No 234C interest on shortfall attributable to capital gains, dividend, lottery/games winnings, or first-time business income arising AFTER an instalment date, if the tax on it is paid in remaining instalments or by 31 March (proviso to s.234C(1))
interest_and_fees.fee_234i_revised_after_dec31: Fee under s.234I on revised returns filed after 31 Dec of the AY-1 year, up to 31 Mar (Finance Act 2026) — amount per the Act; verify before quoting
interest_and_fees.rounding: Rule 119A: each interest base rounds DOWN to nearest 100; part-months count as full

tds_thresholds_common.note: Per-deductor thresholds — aggregate income across banks routinely exceeds them with zero TDS anywhere. Absence of TDS is NEVER evidence of absence of taxable income.

80d.senior_medical_expenditure: allowed within the senior cap only where the senior holds NO health-insurance policy

reporting_thresholds.schedule_al_note: raised from 50L to 1Cr — verify against the current year's notified forms
